items.your_version: So you can tell what each new thing does, add them one at a time, starting with the UMP trial and working down the list below to the keto diet. 5-HTP could help your mood here, though iboga acts on serotonin too, so don't take 5-HTP at all while you're microdosing iboga or elliptica. There isn't enough data to say you should or shouldn't use UMP with any microdose, nor whether 5-HTP would be good with a mushroom microdose, so try those combos if you want and see how it feels. If you're too numb to tell, compare your sleep and dreams on the nights after each kind of day. Mushrooms act on serotonin too, just not the way iboga does, so stop the 5-HTP if you get any of the stop signs the 5-HTP section lists.
